rationale: Laravel preserves the desktop SetLanguage browser-preference contract through its native queued-cookie factory: supported en/ar values are retained, unsupported values fall back to en, the preference lasts one year, SameSite is Lax, HttpOnly is disabled for the UI preference, and Secure follows the current HTTPS request.

runtime_behavior.supported_match: case-insensitive with original supported value preserved
runtime_behavior.production_probe: resolve writer from Laravel container and inspect the actual queued response cookie

acceptance: canonical operation provenance is pinned to AIMW-PLAT-04D5067C61
supported ar/en values are queued under AIWM.Language
unsupported values fall back to en
cookie lifetime and SameSite/HttpOnly contract match the desktop operation
HTTPS requests produce a Secure cookie
